verdict.rationale: Modal is a serverless compute platform, so outbound event webhooks are a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence shows that Modal offers registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for platform events. Its ability to turn functions into HTTPS endpoints (modal-docs-14) is an inbound developer building block and does not count as event subscription via webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
